studies.title: Mount Kailash
studies.caption: Bands of dark rock and snow mark Kailash’s steep face above the open Tibetan plateau.
studies.prompt: View from a stony Tibetan valley toward Mount Kailash's distinctive steep nearly pyramidal layered rock face, horizontal strata and vertical snow-filled groove, snow on upper shoulders, sparse brown foreground. No climbers, summit flag or invented temple.
